description: The budget ledger of the query engine's tests (zhang-query/tests/engine/server_features/budgets), in UTC+8: activity converted at each posting's date through the inverse of the only prices (CNY quoted in USD), a budget-add and a posting in the first half hour of a month (still the previous month in UTC) counted in the ledger date's month, a leap day, a transfer, a close, and a budget-add to a budget that does not exist.

known_issues.round_trip.beancount: KNOWN-ISSUE: a budget directive with a time is written to beancount with its date and time (`2024-02-15 18:00:00 custom "budget-close" "Fun"`), which zhang's beancount parser cannot read, so the round trip does not load, and which bean-check 3.2.3 rejects (`syntax error, unexpected NUMBER`); other directives move their time into a `time` metadata entry (extensions/beancount/src/lib.rs:163-169)

request.bql: SELECT name, date, currency, alias, category, accounts, close, close_time FROM #budget_definitions
SELECT name, date, time, timestamp, type, amount FROM #budget_events
SELECT name, date, year, month, currency, alias, category, assigned, added, activity, available, closed, accounts FROM #budgets
SELECT date, time, account, narration, units(position) AS units, budgets FROM #postings
